events.what: Arslanov and Bui identify an error in Chung-Graham's 2019 calculation of W_5, invalidating the claimed O(x^0.6) bound and reverting the rigorous bound to O(x^{(3+sqrt(2))/7} log x)
Bui shows only 'good squares' need be considered for the Roth-Vaughan lower bound, simplifying its proof without changing the bound
Bui gives a new construction rigorously proving W(x)=O(x^0.6)
McClenagan independently proves W(x)=O(x^0.6) by a different construction (2024 UNBC master's thesis; arXiv writeup 2026-02-01)

judgement.doubts: Whether this is movement at all is debatable: O(x^0.6) was the published, believed bound (Chung-Graham 2019) at the snapshot, so the 2025-26 work restores rather than advances the believed frontier; relative to the rigorously established bound after the 2025 erratum it is a moved bound, so progress is kept. McClenagan's thesis is dated only to 2024 and cannot be placed either side of 26 January 2024; a thesis approved by a committee would count as digested, but either way the tier is progress.

corrections.why: F14: the status is progress (a moved upper bound on a quantity whose growth rate stays open, as the summary itself says); progress rows carry null direction, and 'confirming' Chung-Graham's bound is not confirming an answer to the bullet.
other: credited_humans describes the bound-moving event(s); Arslanov co-authored the erratum invalidating Chung-Graham, which moved no bound upward in knowledge and cannot set the status.

other: kept, with doubt — the restored O(x^0.6) bound equals the bound believed at the snapshot (competing_reading), so the 'progress' is recovery of an invalidated published result; it is a moved bound only relative to the post-erratum rigorous state.
